曲子的调——定了调不能中途转
谱面记号——小，但少一个就走样

hiddenLineText: 「越常用的词，越不规则」——当你发现这不是一堆乱七八糟的例外，而是同一条规律在反复出现，整个英语就变得有秩序了。

lessons.title: be 动词：英语的等号
lessons.hiddenLineNote: be 是英语里最常用的动词，所以它最不规则：am / is / are / was / were 长得完全不像一家人——它是几个古老词根缝起来的「缝合怪」。越常用，越不规则，这是第一次遇见这条规律。

sections.text: 中文说「我很开心」，不需要「是」。英文必须写 I am happy——be 就是英语的等号。想想数学：写「3+2 5」谁看得懂？等号没了，句子就断了。英文里 I very happy 就是「3+2 5」。
am 只跟 I；is 跟一个人/一件东西（he, she, it, my dog）；are 跟你和一群（you, we, they, my friends）。
was = am/is 的过去；were = are 的过去。讲昨天的事，等号也要换成昨天的。
后面是「什么样 / 是什么 / 在哪里」的时候：I am eleven. She is a violinist. They are in the music room. 后面是动作（play, run, eat）就不用 be——动作自己会当节拍。

examples.en: I am in the school orchestra.
My violin is old but beautiful.
We were tired after the concert.
I play the violin every day.
examples.note: 有动作 play → 不用 be

lessons.accept: 验收：给 6 个中文句子口头翻译，「等号句」全都带上 am/is/are/was/were，「动作句」全都不多加 be。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：不用讲语法。她说出 I very happy 时，只重复一遍正确的 I am very happy 让她跟读，不解释为什么。一天抓三次就够。

exercises.q: I ___ eleven years old.
exercises.explain: I 只配 am。

exercises.q: My best friend ___ good at drawing.
exercises.explain: 一个人 → is。

exercises.q: We ___ at the concert last night.
exercises.explain: last night 是过去，we → were。

exercises.q: 改错：I very hungry now.
exercises.explain: 「什么样」的句子必须有等号 am。

exercises.q: 改错：She is play the piano every day.
exercises.answer: She plays the piano every day.
exercises.explain: 有动作 play 就不要 be——等号和节拍不能同时抢一个位置。

exercises.q: The books ___ on the desk yesterday.
exercises.explain: books 是复数 + yesterday → were。

exercises.q: The music room ___ next to the library.
exercises.explain: 一间教室 → is。

exercises.q: My shoes ___ wet because of the rain.
exercises.explain: shoes 复数 + 现在 → are。

exercises.q: I ___ at my grandma's house last weekend.
exercises.explain: last weekend + I → was。

exercises.q: Look! The baby pandas ___ so cute!
exercises.explain: 复数 + 现在 → are。

exercises.q: My father ___ a doctor. He works at the city hospital.
exercises.explain: 「是什么」→ 等号 is。

exercises.q: 改错：She very tall.
exercises.explain: 红区错误2：「什么样」的句子缺等号。

exercises.q: 改错：They was late for school yesterday.
exercises.answer: They were late for school yesterday.
exercises.explain: they 配 were。

exercises.q: 改错：I am agree with you.
exercises.explain: agree 是动作，动作句不要多加 be——等号和节拍不同时上。

exercises.q: 把句子变成过去（昨天）：I am at the music club.
exercises.answer: I was at the music club.
exercises.explain: am 的昨天形状是 was。

exercises.q: 口头验收：翻译成英文——我的书包很重。
exercises.answer: My school bag is very heavy.
exercises.explain: 验收题：等号句必须带 is。

teaching.essence: be 动词就是英语的等号：把「谁」和「是什么 / 怎么样 / 在哪里」连起来。
teaching.why: 中文说「我很开心」，三个字直接连——「很」悄悄占了动词的位置，所以你感觉不到少了什么。但英语有条铁规矩：每句话必须有一个动词。句子里没有动作时，be 就顶上来当那个动词。省了它，句子就像「3+2 5」——少了等号，谁也看不懂。

rules.point: 现在的三副面孔：am / is / are
rules.detail: am 只跟 I；is 跟一个人或一件东西（he / she / it / my dog）；are 跟 you 和一群（we / they / my friends）。

examples.en: I am a violinist.
She is my best friend.
They are in the same class.

rules.point: 过去的两副面孔：was / were
rules.detail: was 是 am/is 的过去；were 是 are 的过去。讲昨天的事，等号也要换成昨天的。

examples.en: I was tired after the rehearsal.
We were at the concert last night.

rules.point: 什么时候必须有等号
rules.detail: 后面是「什么样 / 是什么 / 在哪里」时必须用 be；后面是动作（play / like / run）时不用 be——动词自己上场。

examples.en: My violin is old but beautiful.
I play the violin every day.
examples.zh: 我每天拉小提琴。（动作句，不加 be）

rules.point: 否定和疑问，be 自己搞定
rules.detail: be 是全班唯一不用请 do 帮忙的动词：否定直接在后面加 not；提问直接把 be 搬到句子最前面。

examples.en: She is not at home.
Are you ready?

notes: 「有动作就别加 be」：× I am like music → ✓ I like music。学会 be 之后最常见的新错误反而是到处乱加 be。
中文的「很」不等于 very：「我很开心」里的「很」只是占位，I am happy 已经完整，不是非要 I am very happy。
表示「某处有什么」用 There is / There are，后面跟单数用 is、复数用 are。
年龄、位置、身份都走 be：I am eleven. / He is at school. / She is a doctor.——中文这三种都可以不用动词，英文一个都不能省。

commonErrors.why: 中文「我很开心」没有动词，「很」占了动词的位置，所以中国孩子最爱漏 be。这是 8 类中式错误的 2 号（红区）。
否定句也要先有等号才能否定——not 只能挂在 be 后面，不能自己站着。
中文的「是」永远一个样，英语的等号要跟主语换面孔：they 配 are。
中文说昨天的事动词不变（「我昨天在学校」），英语的等号要跟着时间变成 was/were。接 3 号错误「叙事时态跳」（红区）。

commonErrors.wrong: I am like playing the violin.
commonErrors.why: 矫枉过正：怕漏 be 就到处塞 be。记住一句话只要一个动词——有 like 这个动作，be 就得下场。

teaching.parentTip: 不用讲语法。她说出 I very happy 时，只重复一遍正确的 I am very happy 让她跟读，不解释为什么；让她把句子读出来，漏了 am/is/are 会觉得「缺了一个音」，比讲规则管用。
teaching.darkline: be 是英语里最常用的动词，所以它最不规则：am / is / are / was / were 长得完全不像一家人——它是几个古老词根缝起来的「缝合怪」。越常用，越不规则，这是你第一次遇见这条规律。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I am eleven.
questions.explain: 对。I 配 am，「我 11 岁」的等号在。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I very happy.
questions.explain: 错。少了等号 am：I am very happy. 中文「我很开心」没动词，英文必须有。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ She is my friend.
questions.explain: 对。she 是一个人，配 is。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ They is happy.
questions.explain: 错。they 是一群人，要配 are：They are happy.

questions.q: I ___ a student.
questions.explain: am 只跟 I，这是它俩的专属搭配。

questions.q: He ___ tall.
questions.explain: he 是一个人 → is。

questions.q: You ___ my best friend.
questions.explain: you 永远配 are（哪怕只指一个人）。

questions.q: My dog ___ cute.
questions.explain: my dog 是一只（相当于 it）→ is。

questions.q: We ___ in the music room.
questions.hint: 提示：we / you / they 用同一个
questions.explain: we 是一群人 → are。

questions.q: It ___ a sunny day.
questions.explain: it → is。天气、日期常用 It is…开头。

questions.q: Yesterday I ___ tired.
questions.explain: yesterday 是过去 → 等号换成过去的 was。

questions.q: They ___ at the concert last night.
questions.explain: last night 是过去，they → were。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I am play the piano.
questions.explain: 错。play 是动作，动作句不用 be：I play the piano. 一句话只要一个动词。

questions.q: My shoes ___ new.
questions.explain: shoes 是两只、复数 → are。

questions.q: I ___ eleven years old.
questions.hint: 提示：只跟 I 的那个
questions.explain: 说年龄用 be：I am eleven (years old).

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ The apples were sweet.
questions.explain: 对。apples 复数、讲过去 → were，完全正确。

questions.q: My mother ___ a teacher.
questions.explain: my mother 是一个人 → is。be 原形不能直接放在这里。

questions.q: I ___ in Grade Five.
questions.explain: I 只配 am。说「在几年级」也是位置/身份 → 用 be。

questions.q: Tom and I ___ good friends.
questions.explain: Tom and I 是两个人 = we → are。

questions.q: The weather ___ cold today.
questions.explain: weather 是一件事物、today 是现在 → is。

questions.q: ___ you ready?
questions.explain: 问句直接把 be 搬到最前面：You are ready. → Are you ready?

questions.q: My parents ___ at work now.
questions.explain: parents 爸爸妈妈两个人 → are；now 是现在，不用过去式。

questions.q: There ___ a violin on the chair.
questions.explain: There is/are 表「有」：后面 a violin 是单数 → is。

questions.q: There ___ two cakes on the table.
questions.explain: two cakes 复数 → are。There is/are 看后面的东西是几个。

questions.q: Last year she ___ in Class One.
questions.explain: last year 过去 + she 单数 → was。

questions.q: We ___ late for school yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday 过去 + we 复数 → were。

questions.q: Look! The babies ___ so cute.
questions.explain: babies 复数、眼前的事是现在 → are。

questions.q: My favourite subject ___ music.
questions.explain: 主语是 my favourite subject（一件事）→ is，别被后面的词带偏。

questions.q: The concert ___ wonderful last night.
questions.explain: last night 过去 + the concert 单数 → was。

questions.q: I ___ not afraid of dogs.
questions.explain: 否定句也要先有等号：I am not…，not 挂在 am 后面。

questions.q: Where ___ my keys? I can't find them.
questions.explain: keys 复数 → are。问「在哪里」就是问位置 → 用 be。

questions.q: Miss Li and Mr Wang ___ our music teachers.
questions.explain: 两位老师 = they → are。

questions.wrong: I very happy today.
questions.explain: 2 号中式错误（红区）：中文「我很开心」没动词，英文必须补上等号 am。

questions.wrong: She not at home.
questions.explain: not 不能自己站着，必须挂在 be 后面：is not。

questions.wrong: They is in the same class.
questions.answer: They are in the same class.
questions.explain: they 配 are。中文「是」永远一个样，英语等号要换面孔。

questions.wrong: Yesterday I am at my grandma's house.
questions.answer: Yesterday I was at my grandma's house.
questions.explain: 时间是昨天，等号也要变成昨天的：am → was。这就是「叙事时态跳」（红区 3 号）。

questions.wrong: I am agree with you.
questions.explain: agree 本身就是动词，一句话只要一个动词，be 得下场。

questions.wrong: My brother are a doctor.
questions.explain: my brother 一个人 → is。

questions.wrong: We was tired after the trip.
questions.answer: We were tired after the trip.
questions.explain: we 复数，过去用 were 不用 was。

questions.wrong: I am like playing the violin.
questions.explain: 矫枉过正型错误：有动作 like 就不要 be。

questions.from: She is a nurse.
questions.explain: be 句子提问不请外援：把 is 直接搬到最前面。

questions.from: They are in the library.
questions.answer: They are not in the library.
alt: They aren't in the library.
questions.explain: 否定：not 挂在 are 后面。

questions.from: You are ready.
questions.explain: are 搬家到句首，句号换问号。

questions.from: He was at school yesterday.
questions.explain: 过去式一样搬家：was 提到最前面。

questions.from: I am good at maths.
questions.answer: I am not good at maths.
alt: I'm not good at maths.
questions.explain: not 挂在 am 后面。注意 am not 没有缩写 amn't。

questions.q: 下面哪一句是对的？
questions.explain: I am tired 状态句用 be ✓。B 多了 be，C 少了 be，D 配错了 be。

questions.q: 下面哪一句是错的？
questions.explain: play 是动作，不能 be+动作原形连用：We play games. 其余三句都对。

questions.q: 选出正确的疑问句：
questions.explain: 疑问句要把 be 搬到句首，且 they 配 are。B 没搬家（口语能懂但考试算错），C 配错，D 用了原形。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Hi Anna! I ___ in London with my family this week.
questions.explain: 「在哪里」→ be；I → am。Part 5 每空只填一个词。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My hotel room ___ very big and clean.
questions.explain: 房间是一件东西、说的是现在 → is。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：There ___ lots of interesting shops near our hotel.
questions.explain: lots of shops 复数 → There are。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：The people here ___ very friendly.
questions.explain: 陷阱：people 看着没有 s，其实是复数（很多人）→ are。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Yesterday we ___ at the science museum all day.
questions.explain: yesterday + we → were。看到时间词先定时态再选 be。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：It ___ my birthday last Sunday.
questions.explain: last Sunday 过去 + it → was。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：We had a party, and my favourite present ___ a new schoolbag.
questions.explain: 整段讲过去的生日 → 时态要一致，用 was。这是 Part 7 写作最容易跳时态的地方。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Dear Tom, thank you for your letter. I ___ very happy to hear from you.
questions.explain: 写信开头说「现在的心情」→ I am。

questions.q: KET 写作想说「音乐会太棒了」，哪句能拿分？
questions.explain: 过去的事 → was。B 缺 be（红区错误），C 时态和 yesterday 打架，D 缺冠词又缺 be。

questions.q: 朋友发消息问 Where are you? 哪个回答语法正确？
options: I am at the bus stop.
I am at the bus stop yesterday.
questions.explain: 位置 → be。B 缺 am，C 主语用错格，D 现在的问题不能配 yesterday。

questions.q: 看图写句：图里两只猫在椅子上。哪句对？
options: There are two cats on the chair.
There is two cats on the chair.
There are two cat on the chair.
Have two cats on the chair.
questions.explain: two cats 复数 → are + cats。中文「有两只猫」的「有」在这里是 There are，不是 have。

questions.q: KET 口语 Part 1 考官问 How old are you? 最好的回答是：
questions.explain: 年龄用 be：I am eleven (years old). B 漏 be；D 是法语/西语的说法，英语不用 have 说年龄。

questions.wrong: My school are big and beautiful.
questions.answer: My school is big and beautiful.
questions.explain: 写作自查题：my school 是一个地方 → is。写完作文回头专查 be 配没配对。

questions.wrong: Last weekend we are at the beach with our cousins.
questions.answer: Last weekend we were at the beach with our cousins.
questions.explain: Part 7 高频考点：时间词 last weekend 一出现，整句动词都要过去式。

questions.from: The film was interesting.
questions.explain: 口语 Part 2 常要互相提问：was 搬到句首即可。

questions.q: 综合：My sister and I ___ members of the school orchestra.
questions.explain: my sister and I = we → are。说「是……的成员」身份 → be。

lessons.title: 疑问句与助动词：指挥的起拍手势

sections.h: do 是唯一没有意思的词
sections.text: do/does/did 自己没有任何意思，它只负责举手——像指挥的起拍手势：不发声，但全团知道要开始了。问句把它举到句首，全世界就知道你在提问。

sections.h: 四百年前的英国人也说 Like you music?
sections.text: 莎士比亚时代的英语真的把动词直接搬到句首提问。后来英语改了规矩：动词不许动，派 do 去句首站岗。所以 You like music? 不是错得离谱，是晚了四百年。
did 已经举了「过去」的牌子，后面动词就回到原形：Did you watch...? 不是 Did you watched。一支乐队只需要一个指挥。

sections.h: be 动词的句子不用请 do
sections.text: be 自己就是等号，自己会走到句首：Are you ready? Was she late? 只有动作句才需要 do 来帮忙。

examples.en: Do you like pop music?
Does your brother play football?
Did you practise the violin yesterday?
examples.note: did 标过去，practise 回原形

examples.en: Are you in Grade 6?
examples.note: be 句自己上，不请 do

lessons.accept: 验收：任给陈述句，3 秒内改成疑问句和否定句。如 She likes cats. → Does she like cats? / She doesn't like cats.
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：玩「快问快答」——你说中文问题（你喜欢…吗？），她 3 秒内说英文问句。她漏了 Do，你只把 Do 补在句首重复一遍。

exercises.q: 把陈述句改成疑问句：You like ice cream.
exercises.explain: 请 do 到句首举手。

exercises.q: 改成疑问句：She plays tennis on Sundays.
exercises.answer: Does she play tennis on Sundays?
exercises.explain: does 举手后 plays 变回 play——时态只标一次。

exercises.q: 改成否定句：They went to the zoo.
exercises.answer: They didn't go to the zoo.
exercises.explain: did 标了过去，went 回原形 go。

exercises.q: 改错：You like music?（书面）
exercises.explain: 8 类错误第 1 类：问句缺助动词，会挡意思。

exercises.q: 改错：Did you watched the film?
exercises.explain: 时态只标一次：did 举了牌，watch 回原形。

exercises.q: ___ your sister at home now?
exercises.explain: at home 是「在哪里」的 be 句，be 自己上。

exercises.q: 改成疑问句：Your sister likes drawing.
exercises.explain: she → does，likes 变回 like。

exercises.q: 改成疑问句：They watched a film last night.
exercises.answer: Did they watch a film last night?
exercises.explain: did 标过去，watch 回原形。

exercises.q: 改成否定句：I like carrots.
exercises.explain: 否定也要请 do：do not / don't。

exercises.q: 改成否定句：He went to the party.
exercises.answer: He didn't go to the party.
exercises.explain: didn't + go（原形）。

exercises.q: ___ your grandpa drink tea every morning?
exercises.explain: 第三人称单数 → Does。

exercises.q: ___ you at school yesterday?
exercises.explain: at school 是 be 句，be 自己上：Were you…?

exercises.q: What time ___ the shop open on Sundays?
exercises.explain: the shop 单数 → does。

exercises.q: 改错：Does she likes music?
exercises.explain: 时态和人称只标一次：does 举了牌，like 回原形。

exercises.q: 改错：You went where yesterday?（书面）
exercises.explain: 疑问词到句首 + did 举手 + go 原形。

exercises.q: 3 秒验收：改成疑问句——She plays chess.
exercises.explain: 验收标准：3 秒内完成这个变形。

teaching.essence: do / does / did 是指挥的起拍手势——自己没有意思，只负责举手告诉全世界：这是个问句（或否定句）。
teaching.why: 中文提问只要在句尾加「吗」：「你喜欢音乐吗？」句子其他部分一个字不动。所以中国孩子最自然的英语问句是 You like music?——这不是瞎错，四百年前的英国人真的这么说（莎士比亚时代把动词搬到句首提问）。后来英语改了规矩：动词不许动，派一个没有意思的 do 去句首站岗。你要做的只是把「吗」翻译成句首的 Do。

rules.point: 动作句提问：句首举 do / does / did
rules.detail: 一般问句 = Do/Does/Did + 主语 + 动词原形。do 配 I/you/we/they；does 配 he/she/it；did 配所有人的过去。

examples.en: Do you like pop music?
Does your brother play football?
Did you practise the violin yesterday?

rules.point: 时态只标一次：does/did 举了牌，动词回原形
rules.detail: 一支乐队只需要一个指挥。does 已经带了「三单」的信息，did 已经带了「过去」的信息，后面的动词必须脱掉标记回到原形。

examples.en: Did you watch the film? (不是 Did you watched)
Does she like cats? (不是 Does she likes)

rules.point: 否定句：do + not 站在动词前面
rules.detail: 否定 = 主语 + don't / doesn't / didn't + 动词原形。同样，时态标在 do 身上，动词回原形。

examples.en: I don't eat meat.
She doesn't play the piano.
We didn't go to school yesterday.

rules.point: be 动词的句子不请 do
rules.detail: be 自己就是等号，自己会走到句首、自己会带 not。只有动作句才需要 do 帮忙。判断方法：句子里有没有 am/is/are/was/were？有就让它自己上。

examples.en: Are you in Grade 6?
Was she late this morning?

rules.point: 特殊疑问词站最前面
rules.detail: What / Where / When / Who / Why / How 先站句首，后面照旧接 do 问句或 be 问句：疑问词 + do/does/did/be + 主语…

examples.en: Where do you live?
What is your favourite subject?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

notes: 先看句子里有没有 be（am/is/are/was/were）：有 be → be 自己搬家；没 be → 请 do 家族。两条路永远不会同时走。
do 也能当普通动词「做」：Do you do your homework? 第一个 Do 是举手的，第二个 do 才是「做」。
回答问句用同一家人：Do you…? → Yes, I do. / Are you…? → Yes, I am. 用什么问就用什么答。
否定缩写口语最常用：don't / doesn't / didn't。KET 听力里几乎只出现缩写形式，要听得出来。

commonErrors.why: 中文只在句尾加「吗」，句子不动，所以最容易整句照搬只改语调。这是 8 类中式错误的 1 号（红区）——口语里对方可能当成陈述句。
时态标了两次。did 已经举了「过去」的牌子，动词必须回原形——一支乐队只要一个指挥。
同样是双重标记：does 已经带了三单信息，likes 的 s 要脱掉。
中文「我不喜欢」直接加「不」，英文的 not 不能自己站在动作前，要 do 陪着：don't like。
两条路挤到一条道上了：句子里有 are（be 句），be 自己搬家就行，不请 do。

teaching.parentTip: 玩「快问快答」：你说中文问题（你喜欢…吗？），她 3 秒内说英文问句。她漏了 Do，你只把 Do 补在句首重复一遍让她跟读，不解释。

questions.q: 这个问句对吗？→ Do you like music?
questions.explain: 对。动作句提问，句首举 Do。

questions.q: 这个问句对吗？→ You like music?
questions.explain: 错（考试里）。中文加个「吗」就行，英文必须请 Do 到句首：Do you like music?

questions.q: 这个问句对吗？→ Are you ready?
questions.explain: 对。有 are 的句子，be 自己搬到句首，不请 do。

questions.q: 这个问句对吗？→ Do you are happy?
questions.explain: 错。句子里有 are → be 句，自己搬家：Are you happy? do 和 be 不同台。

questions.q: 「你喜欢猫吗？」句首应该举谁？___ you like cats?
questions.explain: like 是动作 → 请 do 家族；you 配 do。

questions.q: ___ she play the piano?
questions.explain: she 是三单 → does。

questions.q: ___ they live in Beijing?
questions.explain: they → do。

questions.q: ___ your father drink tea?
questions.explain: your father 是一个人（= he）→ does。

questions.q: 昨天的事怎么问？___ you sleep well last night?
questions.explain: last night 过去 → did。did 对所有主语通用。

questions.q: 这个否定句对吗？→ I don't like coffee.
questions.explain: 对。否定 = don't + 动词原形。

questions.q: 这个否定句对吗？→ I not like coffee.
questions.explain: 错。not 不能自己站在动作前面，要 do 陪着：I don't like coffee.

questions.q: She ___ eat fish.（她不吃鱼）
questions.explain: she 三单 → doesn't。

questions.q: ___ you have a pet?
questions.explain: 动作句 + you → Do。

questions.q: ___ it rain yesterday?
questions.explain: 过去的事 → Did，对所有主语都一样。

questions.q: 哪个是正确的回答？— Do you like dogs? — Yes, ___
questions.explain: 用什么问就用什么答：Do 问 → do 答。Yes, I do.

questions.q: 这个问句对吗？→ Where do you live?
questions.explain: 对。疑问词 Where 站最前，后面照旧 do + 主语 + 动词原形。

questions.q: ___ your friends like playing games?
questions.explain: friends 复数 → do；like 是动作句，不用 be。

questions.q: ___ your sister go to school by bus?
questions.explain: your sister = she → does；说的是平时习惯，用现在。

questions.q: ___ you at home last night?
questions.explain: 句子没有动作、说「在家」是位置 → be 句；last night 过去 + you → Were。

questions.q: ___ you watch TV last night?
questions.explain: watch 是动作 + last night 过去 → Did。上一题对比：有动作请 did，没动作用 were。

questions.q: He ___ like vegetables.
questions.explain: he 三单 + 动作 like → doesn't + 原形。

questions.q: We ___ go to the park yesterday because of the rain.
questions.explain: go 是动作 + yesterday 过去 → didn't + go 原形。

questions.q: Does she ___ English every day?
questions.explain: does 已经举了三单的牌子，动词回原形 study。

questions.q: Did you ___ the concert last week?
questions.explain: did 已经标了过去，enjoy 回原形。

questions.q: What ___ your mother do at weekends?
questions.explain: 疑问词 What 在前，your mother 三单 → does。

questions.q: Where ___ you buy that hat?
questions.explain: 「那顶帽子」已经买了 → 过去 → did。

questions.q: — Does Tom play basketball? — Yes, he ___.
questions.explain: 用什么问用什么答：Does 问 → does 答。

questions.q: — Are you eleven? — Yes, ___.
questions.explain: be 问 → be 答，回答时换回自己：I am。

questions.q: I ___ not understand this question.
questions.explain: I + 动作句否定 → do not（don't）。

questions.q: ___ your parents work on Saturdays?
questions.explain: parents 复数 → Do。

questions.q: She ___ not go to the party last Sunday.
questions.explain: last Sunday 过去 → did not（didn't），动词 go 保持原形。

questions.q: What time ___ the film start tonight?
questions.explain: the film = it 三单 → does。疑问词组 What time 站最前。

questions.wrong: You like music?
questions.explain: 1 号中式错误（红区）：中文句尾加「吗」，英文句首举 Do。

questions.wrong: Did you watched the film?
questions.explain: 时态标两次了：did 举过牌，watched 要回原形 watch。

questions.wrong: Does she likes cats?
questions.explain: does 已带三单信息，likes 的 s 脱掉。

questions.wrong: I not like coffee.
alt: I do not like coffee.
questions.explain: not 不能自己站着，请 do 陪同：don't like。

questions.wrong: Do you are a student?
questions.explain: 有 are 的是 be 句，be 自己搬家，不请 do。

questions.wrong: Where you did go last weekend?
questions.answer: Where did you go last weekend?
questions.explain: 语序：疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形。did 要站在 you 前面。

questions.wrong: He doesn't plays football.
questions.explain: doesn't 已带三单，plays 回原形 play。

questions.wrong: Why you are late?
questions.explain: 疑问词后面 be 也要搬到主语前：Why are you…?

questions.from: She likes cats.
questions.explain: she 三单 → Does 举手，likes 脱掉 s 回原形。

questions.from: They went to the zoo.
questions.answer: Did they go to the zoo?
questions.explain: went 是过去 → Did 举「过去」的牌，went 变回 go。

questions.from: He plays the drums.
alt: He does not play the drums.
questions.explain: 三单否定 → doesn't + 原形 play。

questions.from: I watched TV last night.
questions.answer: I didn't watch TV last night.
alt: I did not watch TV last night.
questions.explain: 过去否定 → didn't + 原形 watch。

questions.from: She is a doctor.
questions.explain: 有 is → be 句自己搬家。别惯性加 Do。

questions.q: 辨析：哪句需要请 do 帮忙变问句？
questions.explain: 只有 A 是动作句（play）→ Do you play chess? 其余都有 be，自己搬家。

questions.q: 哪一句是错的？
options: Did she dance at the party?
questions.explain: D 双重过去：did + went。应为 Did you go home early? B 里第二个 do 是动词「做」，没错。

questions.q: 哪一句是对的？
questions.explain: 问职业的固定句式：What does he/she do? 第一个 does 举手，第二个 do 是动词「做（什么工作）」。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：___ you want to come to my party on Saturday?
questions.explain: 动作句问句 + you → Do。信件里邀请常用这个句式。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：What time ___ the museum open at the weekend?
questions.explain: the museum = it → does。问营业时间是 KET 高频场景。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I'm sorry I ___ not reply to your message yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday → did not（didn't）。reply 保持原形。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My little brother ___ not like getting up early.
questions.explain: my brother 三单 → does not（doesn't）。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Where ___ you usually do your homework?
questions.explain: usually 平时的习惯 → 现在；you → do。第二个 do 是动词「做」。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：___ your school have a music club?
questions.explain: your school = it 三单 → Does。have 保持原形。

questions.q: KET 口语 Part 2 要你问同伴关于运动的问题，哪个问句正确？
questions.explain: Do + you + like + 名词/动名词。B 没举手（口语大忌），C 里 like 后要 swimming，D 配错 does。

questions.q: 朋友问 Did you enjoy the film? 你没看成电影，怎么答？
questions.explain: didn't + 原形 see。B/D 双重标记，C 缺 do。

questions.q: KET 听力常出现缩写，Which is correct? — She ___ come to school yesterday because she was ill.
questions.explain: yesterday → didn't。听力里要能分辨 didn't / doesn't 的读音。

questions.q: 写作情境：想写「我妹妹不喜欢蜘蛛」，哪句能拿分？
questions.explain: 三单 → doesn't + 原形 like。B 配错、C 缺 do、D 双重标记。

questions.wrong: Dear Sam, do you free this weekend?
questions.answer: Dear Sam, are you free this weekend?
questions.explain: 写信高频错误：「有空」是状态（free 是形容词）→ be 句：Are you free? 不请 do。

questions.wrong: Why you didn't come to the rehearsal?
questions.answer: Why didn't you come to the rehearsal?
questions.explain: 疑问词后要倒装：didn't 站在 you 前面。

questions.from: Your friend has lunch at school.（问你的同伴）
questions.answer: Do you have lunch at school?
questions.explain: 口语 Part 2 真实任务：把提示卡的第三人称转成问对方的 you 问句。

questions.from: She got up at seven this morning.
questions.answer: Did she get up at seven this morning?
questions.explain: got 是过去 → Did + get 原形。

questions.q: 综合辨析：四句里哪句语法全对？
options: Where did you go on holiday?
Where did you went on holiday?
Where do you went on holiday?
questions.explain: 疑问词 + did + 主语 + 原形 go。B 缺 did，C/D 双重标记。

questions.q: 综合：— ___ your grandparents visit you often? — Yes, they do.
questions.explain: 答句 they do 反推问句用 Do；grandparents 复数。

lessons.title: 一般现在 vs 过去：动词自带时间戳
lessons.hiddenLineNote: went 原本是另一个动词 wend 的过去式，被 go 借来就没还——最常用的 go 连过去式都是借的。又一次：越常用的词，越不规则。40 个不规则动词之所以不规则，恰恰因为它们是英语里最有用的 40 个。

sections.h: 中文动词 vs 英文动词
sections.text: 中文动词像一张没有日期的照片，时间写在便签上（昨天/明天/正在）。英文动词自带日期戳：play 是今天的，played 是昨天的——动词自己变形来报时。
每天都发生、一直是真的 → 用原形（he/she/it 加 -s）：I practise every day. The sun rises in the east.
昨天、上周、去年发生完的 → 动词盖过去戳：规则的加 -ed（played, watched），不规则的换形状（go→went, eat→ate）——40 个常用的要专门背（见不规则动词闯关）。
every day / usually / often → 现在；yesterday / last week / ago → 过去。看到信号词先定调，再选动词形状。

examples.en: I practise the violin every evening.
Last Saturday we visited my grandma.
examples.zh: 上周六我们看望了奶奶。

examples.en: She goes to school by bike.
We ate noodles and then went home.
examples.zh: 我们吃了面然后回家了。

lessons.accept: 验收：给一组带信号词的句子，10 题里 8 题以上能选对现在/过去，并把不规则动词写对。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：晚饭时玩「昨天今天」：她说一件今天常做的事（英文），再把同一件事说成昨天做过的。只听动词有没有变形。

exercises.q: I ___ my homework at seven every day.
exercises.explain: every day → 现在，I → 原形 do。

exercises.q: We ___ a bird show at the zoo last Sunday.
exercises.explain: last Sunday → 过去戳 -ed。

exercises.q: Tom ___ to music club on Fridays.
exercises.explain: 习惯 + he → goes。

exercises.q: Yesterday I ___ (eat) two eggs for breakfast.
exercises.explain: eat 是不规则动词，过去式 ate。

exercises.q: She ___ (buy) a new dress last week.
exercises.explain: -ought 家族：buy→bought。

exercises.q: 改错：I go to the beach last summer.
exercises.answer: I went to the beach last summer.
exercises.explain: last summer 要过去戳：go→went（借来不还的那个）。

exercises.q: My grandma ___ me a story every night when I was small.
exercises.explain: when I was small → 过去，tell→told。

exercises.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees.
exercises.explain: 事实永远为真 → 一般现在，water 三单加 s。

exercises.q: Last night I ___ (sleep) for ten hours!
exercises.explain: 尾巴变 t 家族：sleep→slept。

exercises.q: She usually ___ (go) home by bus.
exercises.explain: usually → 现在，she → goes。

exercises.q: We ___ (see) a rainbow on the way home yesterday.
exercises.explain: 独行侠：see→saw。

exercises.q: My little brother ___ (draw) a cat on my homework last night!
exercises.explain: -ew 家族：draw→drew。

exercises.q: 改错：I eat two eggs this morning.（现在是晚上）
exercises.answer: I ate two eggs this morning.
exercises.explain: 今天早上已过去 → ate。

exercises.q: 改错：He runed to school because he was late.
exercises.answer: He ran to school because he was late.
exercises.explain: run 是不规则动词：run→ran，不加 -ed。

exercises.q: 把句子说成昨天：I sing in the music room.
exercises.answer: I sang in the music room.
exercises.explain: i→a 家族：sing→sang。

exercises.q: 验收：把这句说成习惯（every day）：I drank milk yesterday.
exercises.explain: 过去戳换回现在形状。

teaching.essence: 英文动词自带时间戳：play 是今天的，played 是昨天的——动词自己变形来报时。
teaching.why: 中文动词像一张没有日期的照片，时间写在旁边的便签上：「我昨天吃面」「我明天吃面」——「吃」永远不变。英文反过来：时间戳直接刻在动词身上（eat → ate），便签（yesterday）反而可以不要。所以中国孩子讲故事最容易「便签写了昨天，照片却盖着今天的戳」——这就是最扣分的时态跳。

rules.point: 一般现在：习惯与事实
rules.detail: 每天都发生、一直是真的 → 用原形；主语是 he/she/it（三单）时动词加 -s。

examples.en: I practise the violin every evening.
She goes to school by bike.
The sun rises in the east.
examples.zh: 太阳从东边升起。（永远的事实）

rules.point: 一般过去：讲完的事
rules.detail: 昨天、上周、去年发生完的 → 动词盖过去戳：规则的加 -ed（played / watched），不规则的换形状（go→went, eat→ate），40 个常用的要专门背。

examples.en: Last Saturday we visited my grandma.
examples.zh: 上周六我们看望了奶奶。

examples.en: We ate noodles and then went home.
examples.zh: 我们吃了面然后回家了。（两个动作都盖过去戳）

rules.point: 信号词先定调
rules.detail: every day / usually / often / always → 现在；yesterday / last week / two days ago / in 2020 → 过去。看到信号词先定调，再选动词形状——像先看谱号再读谱。

examples.en: He usually walks to school, but yesterday he took the bus.
examples.zh: 他平时走路上学，但昨天坐了公交。（同一句里两个信号词、两种时态）

rules.point: 讲故事全程一个调：时态一致
rules.detail: 一段话讲过去的事，里面每一个动词都要盖过去戳，不能一句 was 一句 is。定了调不能中途转——这是 KET Part 7 看图写故事的第一评分点。

examples.en: When they were in the lake, they ate some bread.
examples.zh: 他们在湖里的时候吃了些面包。（were 和 ate 同一个调）

notes: 疑问/否定交给 did 之后，动词回到原形：Did you go…? / I didn't go. 时间戳只盖一次（L2 学过）。
规则动词 -ed 的三种读音：/t/（watched）、/d/（played）、/ɪd/（wanted）。读出来帮助记住写法。
拼写小规则：以 e 结尾只加 d（liked）；辅音+y 变 i 加 ed（study→studied）；短元音+单辅音双写（stop→stopped）。
「现在」不等于「此刻正在做」：I play the violin 说的是习惯（我会拉/我常拉），「此刻正在拉」要用 L4 的现在进行时。

commonErrors.wrong: When they are in the lake, they ate some bread.
commonErrors.right: When they were in the lake, they ate some bread.
commonErrors.why: 中文动词不变形，所以讲故事时最容易前半句忘盖过去戳。这是 8 类中式错误的 3 号「叙事时态跳」（红区），Part 7 直接扣分。

commonErrors.wrong: Yesterday I go to the park.
commonErrors.right: Yesterday I went to the park.
commonErrors.why: 便签写了 yesterday，照片却盖着今天的戳。看到过去信号词，动词必须变形。

commonErrors.wrong: He go to school by bus.
commonErrors.right: He goes to school by bus.
commonErrors.why: 三单加 -s。中文完全没有这个规则，所以最容易漏——但它几乎不挡意思（灰区 7 号），考前再抠，平时别反复纠。
把规则套在不规则动词上。go 的过去式是借来的 went——最常用的 40 个动词都不规则，要专门背。
did 已经盖了过去戳，went 要变回 go。时间戳只盖一次。

teaching.parentTip: 晚饭时玩「昨天今天」：她说一件今天常做的事（英文），再把同一件事说成昨天做过的。只听动词有没有变形，变了就过，不用讲为什么。
teaching.darkline: went 原本是另一个动词 wend 的过去式，被 go 借来就没还——最常用的 go 连过去式都是借的。又一次：越常用的词，越不规则。40 个不规则动词之所以不规则，恰恰因为它们是英语里最有用的 40 个。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I play the piano every day.
questions.explain: 对。every day 习惯 → 现在，play 原形。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ Yesterday I play football.
questions.explain: 错。yesterday 是过去的便签，动词要盖过去戳：played。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ Last week we visited the zoo.
questions.explain: 对。last week 过去 → visit + ed。

questions.q: 「每天」的信号词 every day 配哪种动词？
questions.explain: every day / usually / often → 一般现在。

questions.q: 「上周」的信号词 last week 配哪种动词？
questions.explain: yesterday / last… / ago → 一般过去。

questions.q: I ___ my grandma every Sunday.
questions.explain: every Sunday 习惯 → 现在 visit。

questions.q: I ___ my grandma last Sunday.
questions.explain: last Sunday 过去 → visited。和上一题只差一个信号词。

questions.q: She ___ to school by bike.（平时习惯）
questions.explain: she 三单 → go 加 es：goes。

questions.q: go 的过去式是？
questions.explain: go 不规则，过去式是借来的 went。goed 不存在。

questions.q: eat 的过去式是？
questions.explain: eat → ate，不规则动词要专门背。

questions.q: watch 的过去式是 ___。
questions.explain: 规则动词直接加 -ed：watched，读 /t/。

questions.q: We ___ (play) games at the party yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday → played。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ The sun rises in the east.
questions.explain: 对。永远的事实用一般现在；the sun 三单 → rises。

questions.q: They ___ noodles for lunch and then went home.
questions.explain: 后半句 went 已定过去调，前面动作也要过去：ate。

questions.q: have 的过去式是 ___。
questions.explain: have → had，最常用所以不规则。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ Two days ago we watch a film.
questions.explain: 错。ago 是过去信号词 → watched。

questions.q: My father ___ coffee every morning.
questions.explain: every morning 习惯 + my father 三单 → drinks。

questions.q: I ___ up at six yesterday morning.
questions.explain: yesterday → 过去；get 不规则 → got。

questions.q: We ___ to music together every weekend.
questions.explain: every weekend 习惯 + we → 原形 listen。

questions.q: Look at the photo! We ___ this photo in Qingdao last summer.
questions.explain: last summer 过去；take 不规则 → took。

questions.q: My best friend ___ two cats and a dog.
questions.explain: 现在的事实 + 三单 → has（have 的三单是 has）。

questions.q: She ___ her homework at nine last night.
questions.explain: last night → finished。

questions.q: The concert ___ at 7:30 every Friday evening.
questions.explain: 时刻表/固定安排 + the concert 三单 → starts。

questions.q: I ___ a beautiful bird in the park two hours ago.
questions.explain: ago → 过去；see 不规则 → saw。

questions.q: My grandparents ___ in a small town when they were young.
questions.explain: 后半句 were 定了过去调 → lived。

questions.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees.
questions.explain: 科学事实 → 一般现在；water 三单 → boils。

questions.q: study 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 辅音+y → 变 i 加 ed：studied。

questions.q: stop 的过去式是？
questions.explain: 短元音+单辅音 → 双写再加 ed：stopped。

questions.q: She usually ___ (read) books before bed.
questions.explain: usually 习惯 + she 三单 → reads。

questions.q: Last night I ___ (write) a letter to my pen friend.
questions.explain: write 不规则 → wrote。

questions.q: We ___ (buy) some fruit at the market yesterday.
questions.explain: buy 不规则 → bought。

questions.q: My mother ___ (teach) maths at a middle school.（现在的工作）
questions.explain: 现在的事实 + 三单 → teach + es：teaches。

questions.wrong: Yesterday I go to the park with my friends.
questions.answer: Yesterday I went to the park with my friends.
questions.explain: 便签写了 yesterday，动词就要盖过去戳：went。红区错误。

questions.wrong: When they are in the lake, they ate some bread.
questions.answer: When they were in the lake, they ate some bread.
questions.explain: 3 号中式错误「叙事时态跳」：后半句 ate 是过去，前半句也要 were。

questions.wrong: I goed home at five o'clock.
questions.answer: I went home at five o'clock.
questions.explain: go 不规则，不能加 -ed：went。

questions.wrong: She didn't went to school last Friday.
questions.answer: She didn't go to school last Friday.
questions.explain: didn't 已盖过去戳，went 变回 go。时间戳只盖一次。

questions.wrong: Last Sunday we go to the cinema and watched a film.
questions.answer: Last Sunday we went to the cinema and watched a film.
questions.explain: 同一句里 watched 已经是过去，go 也要变 went——全程一个调。

questions.wrong: He get up at seven every day.
questions.answer: He gets up at seven every day.
questions.explain: 三单加 -s：gets。灰区错误，不挡意思，但写作检查时顺手改掉。

questions.wrong: I am watch TV every evening.
questions.explain: 习惯动作直接用动词原形，不加 be——一句话一个动词（复习 L1）。

questions.wrong: They eated all the cakes at the party.
questions.answer: They ate all the cakes at the party.
questions.explain: eat 不规则 → ate。把 -ed 套在不规则动词上是最常见的「过度规则化」。

questions.from: I walk to school.（改成昨天）
alt: Yesterday I walked to school.
I walked to school.
questions.explain: walk 规则 → walked。

questions.from: She has a piano lesson.（改成上周六）
questions.answer: She had a piano lesson last Saturday.
alt: Last Saturday she had a piano lesson.
She had a piano lesson.
questions.explain: has 的过去式是 had。

questions.from: We went to the beach.（改成疑问句）
questions.answer: Did we go to the beach?
alt: Did you go to the beach?
questions.explain: Did 举过去的牌，went 回原形 go。

questions.from: He drinks milk every day.（改成否定句）
questions.answer: He doesn't drink milk every day.
alt: He does not drink milk every day.
questions.explain: 三单否定 → doesn't + 原形 drink。

questions.q: 辨析：He usually ___ to school, but yesterday he ___ the bus.
questions.explain: 一句里两个信号词各管半句：usually → walks（三单），yesterday → took。

questions.q: 哪一句时态是错的？
options: I saw a film last night.
We visit the museum two weeks ago.
They played chess after dinner yesterday.
questions.explain: C 有 ago 却用了现在式 visit → 应为 visited。

questions.q: 讲故事开头是 Last summer, I…，下面哪句能接？
options: I stayed with my aunt in Shanghai.
I stay with my aunt in Shanghai.
I am stay with my aunt.
questions.explain: Last summer 定了过去调，全文动词都盖过去戳：stayed。

questions.q: 选出全对的一句：
options: Tom studied hard and passed the test.
Tom studyed hard and passed the test.
Tom studied hard and pass the test.
Tom studies hard and passed the test.
questions.explain: study→studied（变 i 加 ed），pass→passed，两个动作同调。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Last weekend my family ___ (drive) to the mountains.
questions.explain: last weekend → 过去；drive 不规则 → drove。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：We ___ (see) lots of sheep on the way.
questions.explain: 整段讲上周末 → 保持过去调：saw。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My school ___ (begin) at eight o'clock every morning.
questions.explain: every morning + my school 三单 → begins。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Dear Anna, I ___ (get) your postcard two days ago. Thank you!
questions.explain: ago → 过去：got。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My cousin ___ (come) to my house every Spring Festival.
questions.explain: 每年的习惯 + 三单 → comes。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Yesterday it ___ (rain) all day, so we stayed at home.
questions.explain: yesterday + 后半句 stayed 同调 → rained。

questions.q: KET Part 7 看图写故事，第一句是 One day, Ben and his dog went to the river. 第二句选哪个？
options: The dog jumped into the water.
The dog jumps into the water.
The dog is jump into the water.
The dog jump into the water.
questions.explain: 第一句 went 定了过去调，全文跟着盖过去戳：jumped。这正是 Part 7 的评分点。

questions.q: 故事接龙：…Ben was afraid. He ___ for help.
questions.explain: 前句 was 过去调 → shouted。

questions.q: KET 口语 Part 1：What did you do last weekend? 最好的回答：
options: I visited my grandparents and we made dumplings.
I visit my grandparents and we make dumplings.
I visited my grandparents and we make dumplings.
questions.explain: 问的是 last weekend → 回答里每个动词都要过去式：visited、made。D 前半对后半跳回现在，正是「时态跳」。

questions.q: KET 口语 Part 1：What do you usually do after school? 最好的回答：
options: I usually do my homework and practise the violin.
I usually did my homework and practised the violin.
I am usually do my homework.
questions.explain: 问的是 usually 习惯 → 一般现在。对比上一题：先听清问句的时态，用同一个调回答。

questions.wrong: Last Sunday I get up late, ate a big breakfast and went to the park.
questions.answer: Last Sunday I got up late, ate a big breakfast and went to the park.
questions.explain: 三个动作两个已盖戳（ate/went），get 也要变 got——写作最后要逐个动词检查。

questions.wrong: My father is a driver. He drive a bus in our city.
questions.answer: My father is a driver. He drives a bus in our city.
questions.explain: 介绍职业用一般现在，三单 → drives。

questions.from: They have a picnic by the lake.（改成上周日的事）
questions.answer: They had a picnic by the lake last Sunday.
alt: Last Sunday they had a picnic by the lake.
They had a picnic by the lake.
questions.explain: have → had。

questions.from: I took many photos at the zoo.（改成疑问句问对方）
questions.answer: Did you take many photos at the zoo?
questions.explain: Did 举牌，took 回原形 take，主语换成 you。

questions.q: 综合：Every day I ___ (practise) for half an hour, but last night I ___ (practise) for two hours.（第二空）
alt: practiced
questions.explain: 同一动词两个时态：every day → practise，last night → practised。

questions.q: 综合辨析：哪句的时态全对？
options: When I was little, I liked drawing, and now I like taking photos.
When I was little, I like drawing, and now I like taking photos.
When I am little, I liked drawing.
When I was little, I liked drawing, and now I liked taking photos.
questions.explain: 过去的事 was/liked 一个调，现在的事 like 另一个调——两个调分段用，段内不换调。

lessons.title: 现在进行 + 时态一致：别在半路转调

sections.text: 此刻正在做 → be + 动词-ing：I am doing my homework now. 注意两件套缺一不可——没有 be 的 I doing 和没有 -ing 的 I am do 都不成立。
拉琴时 G 大调拉到一半突然转降 E，全场都会皱眉。写故事也一样：开头用了过去时，整个故事就是过去调，中途不能跳回现在。
看图写故事最容易犯：When they are in the lake they ate...（前半现在、后半过去）。写之前先默念：这个故事发生在过去 → 每个动词都盖过去戳。
写完只检查一件事：把每个动词圈出来，问「它是过去形状吗」。一个不是，改成是。

examples.en: Look! The cat is sleeping on my violin case.
examples.zh: 看！猫正睡在我的琴盒上。

examples.en: One sunny morning, Lily walked to the park. She saw a small dog and gave it some bread.
examples.zh: 一个晴朗的早晨，莉莉走去公园。她看见一只小狗，喂了它一些面包。

examples.en: While we were playing, it started to rain.
examples.zh: 我们玩着玩着开始下雨了。
examples.note: 过去进行 + 一般过去，仍是过去调

lessons.accept: 验收：看三幅图口头讲一个 5 句的故事，时态从头到尾不跳。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：她讲英文小故事时，你不用懂内容，只数动词——听到 is/am/are 混进过去故事里就轻敲一下桌子当「转调提醒」。

exercises.q: Listen! Someone ___ the piano.
exercises.explain: Listen! → 此刻正在 → be+ing。

exercises.q: Last night, Mia ___ a picture and hung it on the wall.
exercises.explain: last night 定了过去调。draw→drew。

exercises.q: 改错：Yesterday Tom went to the river and swims with his friends.
exercises.answer: Yesterday Tom went to the river and swam with his friends.
exercises.explain: 故事已定过去调，swims 是半路转调。swim→swam。

exercises.q: 改错：She is do her homework now.
exercises.answer: She is doing her homework now.
exercises.explain: 进行时两件套：be + -ing，缺一不可。

exercises.q: When I saw him, he ___ under a big tree.
exercises.explain: 过去的正在进行 → was/were + -ing。

exercises.q: 把句子改成正在进行：They play basketball.
exercises.explain: be(are) + playing。

exercises.q: Be quiet! The baby ___.
exercises.explain: 此刻正在 → is sleeping。

exercises.q: Yesterday at eight, we ___ dinner with Grandpa.
exercises.explain: 过去某一刻正在 → were having。

exercises.q: She ___ TV when the phone rang.
exercises.explain: 过去进行 + 一般过去：正在看时电话响了。

exercises.q: Look out of the window! It ___ (snow)!
exercises.explain: Look! → 正在下雪。

exercises.q: 改错：Last Sunday we go to the zoo and saw pandas.
exercises.answer: Last Sunday we went to the zoo and saw pandas.
exercises.explain: 红区错误3：故事定了过去调，go 是半路转调。

exercises.q: 改错：When I opened the door, the cat is sitting on my bed.
exercises.answer: When I opened the door, the cat was sitting on my bed.
exercises.explain: 过去的故事里 is → was。

exercises.q: 改错：They are play football now.
exercises.explain: 两件套：are + playing。

exercises.q: 连成一句故事(全过去)：图1 Tom 在跑步 / 图2 他摔倒了
exercises.answer: Tom was running and he fell down.
exercises.explain: 过去进行 + fell（fall→fell），全程过去调。

exercises.q: 把句子改成正在进行：She reads a book.
exercises.explain: is + reading。

exercises.q: 验收：看图讲故事第一句(过去调)——一个女孩在公园放风筝
exercises.answer: One day, a girl was flying a kite in the park.
exercises.explain: 开头定调：One day + 过去形状。（意思对即可）

teaching.essence: 现在进行 = be + 动词-ing，专拍「此刻正在发生」的直播画面；时态是曲子的调——定了调，整首曲子不能中途转。
teaching.why: 中文说「正在」只加一个词：「我正在写作业」，动词「写」不变。英文要动两处：be 举牌（现在直播中）+ 动词穿 -ing 的演出服，两件套缺一不可。没有 be 的 I doing 和没有 -ing 的 I am do 都不成立。而「调」的问题更隐蔽：中文动词永远不变形，所以中文故事随便讲；英文故事开头定了过去调，后面每个动词都得跟着，一跳调阅卷老师立刻皱眉——就像 G 大调拉到一半突然转降 E。

rules.point: 现在进行的两件套：be + -ing
rules.detail: 此刻正在做 → am/is/are + 动词-ing。be 跟主语换面孔（L1 的规矩），动词穿 -ing 演出服。信号词：now / look! / listen!

examples.en: Look! The cat is sleeping on my violin case.
examples.zh: 看！猫正睡在我的琴盒上。

examples.en: I am doing my homework now.
They are playing basketball in the playground.

rules.point: -ing 的拼写小规则
rules.detail: 一般直接加 ing（playing）；哑音 e 去掉再加（write→writing, make→making）；短元音+单辅音双写（run→running, swim→swimming, sit→sitting）。

examples.en: She is writing a postcard.
examples.zh: 她正在写明信片。（write 去 e）

examples.en: The boys are running to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 男孩们正跑向公交站。（run 双写 n）

rules.point: 一般现在 vs 现在进行：习惯 vs 直播
rules.detail: I play the violin = 我会拉/常拉（习惯，随时为真）；I am playing the violin = 我此刻正在拉（直播画面）。问「平时」用一般现在，问「现在这一刻」用进行。

examples.en: She plays the piano every day, but now she is playing the drums.
examples.zh: 她每天弹钢琴，但此刻正在打鼓。

rules.point: 时态一致：故事从头到尾一个调
rules.detail: 故事开头定了过去调，后面每个动词都盖过去戳；「当时正在做」用过去进行 was/were + -ing——它还是过去调，不算转调。写完自查：把每个动词圈出来，问「它是过去形状吗」。

examples.en: One sunny morning, Lily walked to the park. She saw a small dog and gave it some bread.
examples.zh: 一个晴朗的早晨，莉莉走去公园，看见一只小狗，喂了它面包。（全程过去调）

examples.en: While we were playing, it started to rain.
examples.zh: 我们玩着玩着开始下雨了。（过去进行+一般过去，仍是过去调）

notes: 有些动词几乎不穿 -ing 演出服：like / love / want / know / have（拥有）表示状态而非动作——说 I like music，不说 I am liking music。
Look! / Listen! 开头的句子九成是现在进行——这两个词就是「直播开始」的提示音。
现在进行也能说不满：He is always losing his keys!（总是丢钥匙，带抱怨语气）——KET 不考，听到能懂即可。
判断该用哪个时态的口诀：先找时间词（now? every day? yesterday?），没有时间词就看上下文的调。

commonErrors.why: 两件套丢了 be。中文「我正在写」没有等号，所以 be 最容易丢——本质还是 2 号错误「be 缺失」（红区）。

commonErrors.wrong: Look! She dances on the stage.
commonErrors.right: Look! She is dancing on the stage.
commonErrors.why: Look! 是直播提示音，此刻正在发生 → 要两件套。用一般现在成了「她（平时）在台上跳舞」。

commonErrors.wrong: When they are in the lake, they ate some bread.
commonErrors.right: When they were in the lake, they ate some bread.
commonErrors.why: 3 号错误「叙事时态跳」（红区）：故事是过去调，前半句却跳回现在。Part 7 看图写故事的命门。

commonErrors.wrong: She is runing in the park.
commonErrors.right: She is running in the park.
commonErrors.why: run 短元音+单辅音要双写 n 再加 ing。拼写错在 KET 写作会被扣分但不挡意思。

commonErrors.wrong: I am liking this song very much.
commonErrors.right: I like this song very much.
commonErrors.why: like 是状态动词，不穿 -ing 演出服。状态一直在，不是一场直播。

teaching.parentTip: 她讲英文小故事时，你不用懂内容，只数动词——听到 is/am/are 混进过去的故事里，就轻敲一下桌子当「转调提醒」，让她自己找哪里跳了调。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I am doing my homework now.
questions.explain: 对。两件套齐全：am + doing。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I doing my homework now.
questions.explain: 错。丢了 be：I am doing。两件套缺一不可。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ She is watching TV.
questions.explain: 对。is + watching，两件套齐。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ They are play football now.
questions.explain: 错。丢了 -ing：They are playing。

questions.q: Look! The baby ___ .
questions.explain: Look! 是直播提示音 → 现在进行 is crying。

questions.q: I ___ a book now.
questions.explain: now → 正在 → am reading。

questions.q: We ___ to music at the moment.
questions.explain: at the moment = 此刻 → are listening。

questions.q: write 穿上 -ing 演出服是？
questions.explain: 哑音 e 去掉再加 ing：writing。

questions.q: run 穿上 -ing 演出服是？
questions.explain: 短元音+单辅音 → 双写 n：running。

questions.q: Listen! Someone ___ (sing) in the next room.
questions.explain: Listen! → 现在进行：is singing。

questions.q: The children ___ (swim) in the pool now.
questions.explain: children 复数 → are；swim → swimming。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I am liking this song.
questions.explain: 错。like 是状态动词，不穿 -ing：I like this song.

questions.q: 「她每天弹钢琴」用哪种时态？
questions.explain: every day 是习惯 → 一般现在。进行时只拍「此刻」。

questions.q: 「她此刻正在弹钢琴」用哪种时态？
questions.explain: 此刻直播 → is playing。和上一题对比记。

questions.q: 故事开头是 Last Sunday…，后面动词都要用过去式。这个说法对吗？
questions.explain: 对。开头定了过去调，整个故事不能中途转调。

questions.q: make 穿上 -ing 演出服是？
questions.explain: 哑音 e 去掉：making。

questions.q: Look out of the window! It ___ .
questions.explain: Look! 直播提示音 → is raining。

questions.q: My mother ___ dinner in the kitchen now.
questions.explain: now → is cooking。只有 D 缺 be，别选。

questions.q: The students ___ to the teacher carefully now.
questions.explain: students 复数 → are + listening。

questions.q: I can't answer the phone. I ___ a shower.
questions.explain: 正在洗澡走不开 → am having。这里 have 是「洗（澡）」的动作，能穿 -ing。

questions.q: She usually ___ tea, but today she ___ coffee.
questions.explain: usually 习惯 → drinks；today（此刻例外）→ is drinking。

questions.q: Where is Tom? — He ___ computer games in his room.
questions.explain: 问「人现在在哪/在干嘛」→ 现在进行。

questions.q: The bus ___ ! Run!
questions.explain: 眼看着车来了 → is coming。

questions.q: sit 的 -ing 形式是？
questions.explain: 短元音+单辅音 → 双写 t：sitting。

questions.q: dance 的 -ing 形式是？
questions.explain: 哑音 e 去掉：dancing。

questions.q: My brother ___ TV every evening.
questions.explain: every evening 习惯 → 一般现在，三单 watches。别看到「电视」就上进行时。

questions.q: Be quiet! The baby ___ .
questions.explain: 让人安静是因为「此刻」宝宝在睡 → is sleeping。

questions.q: We ___ for the school concert at the moment.
questions.explain: at the moment → are practising。

questions.q: Look! The dog ___ (run) after a cat.
questions.explain: Look! → is running，双写 n。

questions.q: I ___ (write) a letter to my pen friend now.
questions.explain: now + I → am writing，write 去 e。

questions.q: They ___ (make) a cake for Mum's birthday right now.
questions.explain: right now → are making。

questions.q: She ___ (sit) next to the window at the moment.
questions.explain: sit → sitting 双写 t；she → is。

questions.wrong: I doing my homework now.
questions.answer: I am doing my homework now.
questions.explain: 两件套丢了 be——中文「正在」没有等号，最容易丢 am。

questions.wrong: She is dance on the stage now.
questions.answer: She is dancing on the stage now.
questions.explain: 两件套丢了 -ing：dancing（去 e 加 ing）。

questions.wrong: Look! The boys swimming in the river.
questions.answer: Look! The boys are swimming in the river.
questions.explain: 丢了 are。boys 复数 → are swimming。

questions.wrong: He is runing to school because he is late.
questions.answer: He is running to school because he is late.
questions.explain: 拼写：run 双写 n 再加 ing。

questions.wrong: I am wanting a new schoolbag.
questions.explain: want 是状态动词，不穿 -ing。想要不是一场直播。

questions.wrong: When they are in the lake, they ate some bread.
questions.answer: When they were in the lake, they ate some bread.
questions.explain: 时态跳（红区 3 号）：故事过去调，are 要变 were。

questions.wrong: Yesterday Lily walked to the park and sees a small dog.
questions.answer: Yesterday Lily walked to the park and saw a small dog.
questions.explain: 前半 walked 过去调，后半 sees 跳回现在 → saw。

questions.wrong: While we played, it was starting to rain.（表达「玩着玩着开始下雨」）
questions.answer: While we were playing, it started to rain.
questions.explain: while 引导的背景动作用过去进行 were playing，突然发生的事用一般过去 started——位置放反了。

questions.from: She reads a book.（改成此刻正在）
questions.answer: She is reading a book now.
alt: She is reading a book.
questions.explain: 加两件套：is + reading。

questions.from: They are playing chess.（改成疑问句）
questions.explain: 有 be 就让 be 搬家：Are they playing…?（不请 do）

questions.from: He is listening to music.（改成否定句）
questions.answer: He is not listening to music.
alt: He isn't listening to music.
questions.explain: not 挂在 is 后面。

questions.from: I am drawing a picture.（改成疑问句问对方）
questions.explain: 主语 I 换 you，be 也要跟着换：am → are，再搬到句首。

questions.q: 辨析：下面哪句是对的？
options: Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.
Listen! Someone knocks at the door.
Listen! Someone knocking at the door.
Listen! Someone is knock at the door.
questions.explain: Listen! → 现在进行两件套 is knocking。B 时态不对，C 缺 be，D 缺 -ing。

questions.q: 哪句的时态是错的？
options: We are waiting for the bus.
questions.explain: know 是状态动词，不用进行时：I know the answer.

questions.q: 故事片段：Last night I was doing my homework when the lights ___ out.
questions.explain: 背景 was doing（正做着），突发事件用一般过去 went。全句仍是过去调。

questions.q: 选出时态从头到尾不跳的一句：
options: She opened the box and found a little kitten inside.
She opened the box and finds a little kitten inside.
She opens the box and found a little kitten inside.
She opened the box and is finding a little kitten inside.
questions.explain: opened + found 同为过去调 ✓。其余都在半路转调。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I can't come out now. I ___ (help) my mum in the kitchen.
questions.explain: now + 说不能出来 → 正在帮忙：am helping。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Look at the photo! My little sister ___ (wear) my hat. So funny!
questions.explain: 描述照片里正在发生的画面 → is wearing。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Sorry, Dad can't answer the phone. He ___ (drive) now.
questions.explain: 正在开车 → is driving，drive 去 e。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：It's 8 p.m. and we ___ (watch) a film together.
questions.explain: 此刻 8 点正在看 → are watching。

questions.q: KET 口语 Part 2 描述图片：图里一家人在野餐。哪句最好？
options: They are having a picnic in the park.
They have a picnic in the park.
They having a picnic in the park.
They are have a picnic in the park.
questions.explain: 描述图片一律用现在进行（画面就是直播）：are having。这是口语描述图片的万能时态。

questions.q: 描述图片：图里一个男孩在骑车。哪句最好？
options: A boy is riding a bike.
A boy is ride a bike.
questions.explain: 看图说话 → is riding。ride 去 e 加 ing。

questions.q: KET Part 7 写故事第一句：One day, Tom and Anna ___ to the beach.
questions.explain: One day 开头的故事 = 过去调 → went。第一句就把调定好。

questions.q: 故事接龙：While they ___ sandcastles, a big wave came.
questions.explain: 背景动作（正搭着）→ 过去进行 were building；a big wave came 是突发事件。

questions.q: 故事结尾选哪句（保持过去调）？
options: Everyone laughed and went home happily.
Everyone laughs and goes home happily.
Everyone is laughing and going home.
Everyone laughed and go home happily.
questions.explain: 结尾也要过去调：laughed + went。D 后半跳调了。

questions.wrong: 看图写故事（图为过去的事）：Last Sunday, Ben played in the garden. Suddenly he sees a bird on the tree.
questions.answer: Last Sunday, Ben played in the garden. Suddenly he saw a bird on the tree.
questions.explain: Part 7 命门：suddenly 后最容易跳调，sees → saw。

questions.wrong: My friends are play basketball on the playground now.
questions.answer: My friends are playing basketball on the playground now.
questions.explain: 两件套第二件：-ing 不能丢。

questions.wrong: Dear Anna, I write this letter in the garden now. The birds are singing.
questions.answer: Dear Anna, I am writing this letter in the garden now. The birds are singing.
questions.explain: 写信描述「此刻」→ am writing。后半句 are singing 已经给了提示。

questions.from: The girl waters the flowers.（描述眼前图片）
questions.answer: The girl is watering the flowers.
questions.explain: 看图描述 → is watering。

questions.from: They are cleaning the classroom.（改成疑问句）
questions.explain: be 搬家到句首。

questions.q: 综合：口语考官问 What is your friend doing now? 最好的回答：
options: She is probably doing her homework at home.
She does her homework at home.
questions.explain: 问 now → 用进行时回答：is doing。

questions.q: 综合辨析：哪句全对？
options: I usually walk to school, but today I am taking the bus because it is raining.
I usually walking to school, but today I take the bus because it rains.
I usually walk to school, but today I take the bus because it is raining.
I am usually walking to school, but today I am taking the bus.
questions.explain: 习惯 walk（一般现在）+ 今天例外 am taking + 正在下雨 is raining——三个时态各就各位。

lessons.title: 介词：at 是点，on 是面，in 是盒子

sections.text: at = 0 维的点（at the bus stop 站在那个点上）；on = 2 维的面（on the table 贴在面上）；in = 3 维的盒子（in the box 装在里面）。
时刻是点 → at seven, at noon；日期那天是面 → on Monday, on May 1st；月份年份季节是大盒子 → in June, in 2027, in winter。
in Saturday 是黄区错误：不挡意思，但 Part 5 直接扣分。星期几永远 on。
by car / by bus（乘车）、on holiday（度假）、at school（在学校）——这些当一个词背，不拆开想。

examples.en: The concert starts at seven on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 音乐会周五晚上七点开始。
examples.note: 时刻 at + 具体某天晚上 on

examples.en: My cat likes sleeping in a shoe box.
examples.zh: 我的猫喜欢睡在鞋盒里。

examples.en: Your keys are on the piano.
We go to school by bus.

lessons.accept: 验收：Part 5 格式的介词填空 4/6 以上。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：家里随手指东西问「点、面、还是盒子？」——钥匙在桌上（面 on）、袜子在抽屉里（盒 in）、约定七点（点 at）。中文就能玩。

exercises.q: My birthday is ___ October.
exercises.explain: 月份是大盒子 → in。

exercises.q: See you ___ six o'clock!
exercises.explain: 时刻是点 → at。

exercises.q: We play football ___ Saturdays.
exercises.explain: 星期几永远 on（in Saturday 是 Part 5 最爱抓的错）。

exercises.q: There is a map ___ the wall.
exercises.explain: 贴在墙面上 → on。

exercises.q: We went to Shanghai ___ train.
exercises.explain: 交通方式搭配 by train，整块背。

exercises.q: The pencils are ___ my school bag.
exercises.explain: 书包是盒子 → in。

exercises.q: School starts ___ eight o'clock.
exercises.explain: 时刻是点 → at。

exercises.q: We visit Grandma ___ Spring Festival.
exercises.explain: 节日整体常用 at：at Spring Festival。

exercises.q: My birthday is ___ the fifth of June.
exercises.explain: 具体日期 → on。

exercises.q: It often snows here ___ winter.
exercises.explain: 季节是大盒子 → in。

exercises.q: The cat is sleeping ___ the piano.（在钢琴上面）
exercises.explain: 贴着面 → on。

exercises.q: Your socks are ___ the washing machine.
exercises.explain: 洗衣机是盒子 → in。

exercises.q: I cut the paper ___ scissors.
exercises.explain: 用工具 → with scissors。

exercises.q: 改错：See you in Monday morning!
exercises.explain: 具体某天(早上) → on。黄区错误4。

exercises.q: 改错：We went to Shanghai with train.
exercises.answer: We went to Shanghai by train.
exercises.explain: 交通方式 → by train，整块背。

exercises.q: 验收（Part 5 形状）：The concert is ___ Saturday evening.
exercises.explain: 具体某天的晚上 → on Saturday evening。

teaching.essence: 介词是谱面记号——小，但少一个就走样。空间三兄弟：at 是点，on 是面，in 是盒子；时间也长同样的形状。
teaching.why: 中文的方位靠「在……上/里/旁」这些字挂在名词后面，而且很多时候干脆省掉（「我周六去」）。英文把这些小词提到名词前面，而且几乎不能省。好消息是英文介词不是乱选的——它们有几何形状：0 维的点用 at，2 维的面用 on，3 维的盒子用 in。把时间也想象成有形状的东西，一套逻辑管两边。

rules.point: 空间：at 点 / on 面 / in 盒子
rules.detail: at = 站在一个点上（at the bus stop / at the door）；on = 贴在一个面上（on the table / on the wall）；in = 装进一个盒子（in the box / in my bag / in the room）。

examples.en: Your keys are on the piano.
examples.zh: 你的钥匙在钢琴上。（贴着面）

examples.en: My cat likes sleeping in a shoe box.
examples.zh: 我的猫喜欢睡在鞋盒里。（盒子）

examples.en: I'll wait for you at the school gate.
examples.zh: 我在校门口等你。（一个点）

rules.point: 时间：同一套形状
rules.detail: 时刻是点 → at seven / at noon / at night；具体某一天是面 → on Monday / on May 1st / on Friday evening；月、年、季节是大盒子 → in June / in 2027 / in winter / in the morning。

examples.en: The concert starts at seven on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 音乐会周五晚上七点开始。

examples.en: We have a long holiday in summer.
My birthday is on the 3rd of March.
examples.zh: 我的生日是 3 月 3 日。

rules.point: 方向和移动：to / from / into / out of
rules.detail: to 指向目的地（go to school）；from 从哪来（from Beijing）；into 进盒子（jump into the pool）；out of 出盒子。注意 go home / come here 不加 to。

examples.en: We walked from the hotel to the beach.
The frog jumped into the water.

rules.point: 固定搭配整块背
rules.detail: 有些搭配不讲几何，当一个词背：by bus / by car / by bike（乘车）、on foot（步行）、at school / at home（在校/在家）、on holiday（度假）、on TV（在电视上）、listen to / look at / wait for。

examples.en: We go to school by bus, but Dad goes to work on foot.
examples.zh: 我们坐公交上学，爸爸步行上班。

examples.en: I saw the singer on TV last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚在电视上看到那个歌手。

notes: 三个「晚上」：in the evening（傍晚，盒子）、at night（深夜，习惯用 at）、on Friday evening（具体某天的晚上，跟着那天用 on）——最后这个是 Part 5 陷阱王。
next / last / this / every + 时间词前不加介词：I'll see you next week（不是 in next week）。
中文「在」不总是 in：「在公交站」是 at（点），「在墙上」是 on（面）。先想形状再选词。
arrive 的搭配：arrive at 小地方（车站、学校），arrive in 大地方（城市、国家）——小地方是点，大地方是盒子，还是同一套几何。

commonErrors.why: 中文「在周六」只有一个「在」，英文按形状分：星期几是「那一天的面」→ 永远用 on。这是 8 类中式错误的 4 号（黄区）：不挡意思，但 Part 5 直接考。
时刻是 0 维的点 → at。凡是「几点钟」一律 at。

commonErrors.wrong: We went to there by taxi.
commonErrors.why: there / here / home 自带方向，不再加 to。中文「去那里」有「去」有「那里」，容易照搬成 go to there。

commonErrors.right: I listened to music all evening.
commonErrors.why: listen to 是整块搭配，to 不能丢——中文「听音乐」没有那个小词，所以最容易漏。

commonErrors.wrong: My mother goes to work by her car.
commonErrors.right: My mother goes to work by car.
commonErrors.why: by + 交通工具是整块搭配，中间什么都不加（不加 a/the/my）。要说「她的车」就换说法：in her car。

teaching.parentTip: 家里随手指东西问「点、面、还是盒子？」——钥匙在桌上（面 on）、袜子在抽屉里（盒 in）、约定七点（点 at）。中文就能玩，玩熟了她自己会选词。

questions.q: 「在桌子上」——桌面是什么形状？The book is ___ the table.
questions.explain: 贴着面 → on。

questions.q: 「在书包里」——书包是什么形状？The pencil is ___ my bag.
questions.explain: 装进盒子 → in。

questions.q: 「在公交站」——站台是一个点。I'm waiting ___ the bus stop.
questions.explain: 一个点 → at。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ My birthday is on May 2nd.
questions.explain: 对。具体某一天 → on。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ See you in Saturday!
questions.explain: 错。星期几永远 on：on Saturday。Part 5 最爱考这个。

questions.q: The film starts ___ seven o'clock.
questions.explain: 时刻是点 → at seven。

questions.q: We go swimming ___ summer.
questions.explain: 季节是大盒子 → in summer。

questions.q: I was born ___ 2015.
questions.explain: 年份是大盒子 → in 2015。

questions.q: There is a picture ___ the wall.
questions.explain: 墙是竖着的面，贴在上面 → on。

questions.q: We go to school ___ bus.
questions.explain: by + 交通工具，整块背：by bus。

questions.q: My grandma lives ___ Shanghai.
questions.explain: 城市 → in Shanghai。

questions.q: Let's meet ___ the school gate.
questions.explain: 校门口是约定的点 → at。

questions.q: I do my homework ___ the evening.
questions.explain: 傍晚是盒子 → in the evening。

questions.q: The stars come out ___ night.
questions.explain: 深夜习惯用 at night，整块背。

questions.q: We walked ___ the park to the library.
questions.explain: from A to B：从公园到图书馆。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ The frog jumped into the water.
questions.explain: 对。跳「进」水里 → into（进盒子）。

questions.q: My piano lesson is ___ four o'clock ___ Friday.
questions.explain: 时刻 at four + 星期几 on Friday。

questions.q: We visited my aunt ___ the Spring Festival.
questions.explain: 节日期间习惯用 at：at the Spring Festival / at Christmas。

questions.q: The cat is hiding ___ the sofa.
questions.explain: 藏在沙发「下面」→ under。

questions.q: The library is ___ the cinema and the bank.
questions.explain: 在两者「之间」→ between A and B。

questions.q: My school is ___ to the park.
questions.explain: next to = 紧挨着，整块搭配。near 后面不加 to。

questions.q: The dog is sleeping ___ the tree.
questions.explain: 在树「下」→ under the tree。

questions.q: I usually get up ___ 6:30 ___ the morning.
questions.explain: 时刻 at 6:30；早上这个时间段 in the morning。

questions.q: She has been ill ___ Monday.（听懂即可）
questions.explain: since + 起点 = 从周一到现在。KET 读到能懂即可。

questions.q: Look! Your photo is ___ the newspaper!
questions.explain: 报纸内容算「在里面」→ in the newspaper。但「在电视上」是 on TV，整块背。

questions.q: Dad goes to work ___ foot.
questions.explain: 步行是 on foot，唯一不用 by 的交通方式。

questions.q: The plane flew ___ the mountains.
questions.explain: 从上方飞「越过」→ over。on 是贴着，over 是悬空在上。

questions.q: Please listen ___ the teacher carefully.
questions.explain: listen to 整块搭配。

questions.q: We are waiting ___ the bus.
questions.explain: wait for 整块搭配：等某人/某物。

questions.q: Look ___ the blackboard, please.
questions.explain: look at 整块搭配：看向一个点。

questions.q: My cousin comes ___ Canada. She speaks English and French.
questions.explain: come from = 来自。

questions.q: There is a bridge ___ the river.
alt: across
questions.explain: 桥横跨河「上方」→ over/across the river。

questions.wrong: See you in Saturday morning!
questions.explain: 4 号中式错误（黄区）：具体某天的早上跟着那天走 → on Saturday morning。

questions.wrong: The train leaves on 8 o'clock.
questions.explain: 时刻是点 → at 8 o'clock。

questions.wrong: We went to there by taxi.
questions.explain: there 自带方向，不加 to。同理：go home / come here。

questions.wrong: I listened music before bed.
questions.answer: I listened to music before bed.
questions.explain: listen to 的 to 不能丢——中文「听音乐」没有小词，最容易漏。

questions.wrong: She goes to school by her bike.
questions.answer: She goes to school by bike.
questions.explain: by + 交通工具中间什么都不加。要强调她的车可说 on her bike。

questions.wrong: My birthday is in the 5th of July.
questions.answer: My birthday is on the 5th of July.
questions.explain: 具体日期是「那一天的面」→ on。月份才用 in（in July）。

questions.wrong: I'll visit my grandparents in next week.
questions.answer: I'll visit my grandparents next week.
questions.explain: next / last / this / every + 时间词，前面不加介词。

questions.wrong: The bird flew out the window into the garden.
questions.answer: The bird flew out of the window into the garden.
questions.explain: 出盒子是 out of，两个词都要：out of the window。

questions.q: 辨析：「书在桌上」vs「苹果在树上」——The apples are ___ the tree.
questions.explain: 苹果长在树上，贴着树 → on the tree。（外来挂上去的鸟也是 in the tree？——鸟藏在枝叶「里」用 in，长在树上的果实用 on。）

questions.q: 辨析：arrive ___ Beijing / arrive ___ the station
questions.explain: 大地方是盒子 → arrive in Beijing；小地方是点 → arrive at the station。

questions.q: 辨析：哪句是对的？
options: I watched a great film on TV at night.
I watched a great film in TV at night.
I watched a great film on TV in night.
I watched a great film at TV on night.
questions.explain: on TV + at night，两个都是整块搭配。

questions.q: 哪句是错的？
questions.explain: late for school 才对。good at / afraid of / interested in / late for——形容词的搭配也整块背。

questions.from: 中译英：我们周日早上十点在电影院门口见。（用 meet, cinema）
questions.answer: Let's meet at ten o'clock on Sunday morning at the cinema.
alt: We will meet at ten on Sunday morning at the cinema.
Let's meet at ten on Sunday morning at the cinema.
Let's meet at the cinema at ten o'clock on Sunday morning.
Let's meet at the cinema at ten on Sunday morning.
We meet at ten o'clock on Sunday morning at the cinema.
questions.explain: 三个介词各就各位：at ten（点）、on Sunday morning（那天的早上）、at the cinema（约定的点）。

questions.q: 一句里三个空：My aunt lives ___ a small town ___ the south ___ China.
questions.explain: in a town（盒子）+ in the south（方位在内部）+ of China（属于）。

questions.q: 「墙上有个洞」怎么说？
options: There is a hole in the wall.
There is a hole on the wall.
There is a hole at the wall.
There is a hole by the wall.
questions.explain: 洞是「陷进墙里」的 → in the wall；画是「贴在墙面」的 → on the wall。看东西是嵌进去还是贴上去。

questions.wrong: We arrived to the airport at six.
questions.answer: We arrived at the airport at six.
questions.explain: arrive 不搭 to：小地方 arrive at，大地方 arrive in。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My swimming lesson is ___ Tuesday afternoon.
questions.explain: 具体某天的下午 → on Tuesday afternoon。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：School starts ___ half past eight.
questions.explain: 时刻 → at half past eight。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：We are going to Hainan ___ the winter holiday.
alt: during
questions.explain: 假期是一段时间的盒子 → in/during the winter holiday。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：You can put your coat ___ my bed.
questions.explain: 放在床「上」贴着面 → on。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I got a letter ___ my pen friend in London.
questions.explain: 来自朋友 → from。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Let's go ___ the museum ___ bike.（第二空）
questions.explain: to the museum + by bike。by + 交通工具。

questions.q: KET 写作邀请信：「周六下午三点在公园门口见」哪句全对？
options: Let's meet at 3 p.m. on Saturday at the park gate.
Let's meet on 3 p.m. in Saturday at the park gate.
Let's meet at 3 p.m. in Saturday on the park gate.
Let's meet in 3 p.m. on Saturday in the park gate.
questions.explain: at 时刻 / on 星期 / at 地点（约定的点）。写邀请信必用句式。

questions.q: KET 口语描述图片：一只猫在椅子下面睡觉。哪句对？
options: A cat is sleeping under the chair.
A cat is sleeping in the chair.
A cat is sleeping down the chair.
A cat is sleeping at the chair.
questions.explain: 在……下面 → under。

questions.q: 读懂指路（KET 阅读常见）：The bank is ___ the supermarket, so they share a wall.
questions.explain: 共用一面墙说明紧挨着 → next to。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Thank you ___ your birthday present!
questions.explain: thank you for… 整块搭配。写感谢信第一句就用。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I'm really good ___ swimming, but bad at running.
questions.explain: good at / bad at，后半句已给提示。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：I waited you at the bus stop for an hour!
questions.answer: I waited for you at the bus stop for an hour!
questions.explain: wait for 的 for 不能丢。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：My father works in a hospital on the centre of the city.
questions.answer: My father works in a hospital in the centre of the city.
questions.explain: in the centre of… 中心在城市「内部」→ in。

questions.q: 综合：Peter goes ___ school ___ foot, but ___ rainy days he takes the bus.
questions.explain: go to school + on foot + on rainy days（具体的那些天 → on）。

questions.q: 综合辨析：哪句有介词错误？
options: We arrived in London at night.
The cinema is between the two shops.
I'll see you in next Monday.
questions.explain: next Monday 前不加介词。其余全对。

questions.q: 综合：The mouse ran ___ of the box and hid under the bed.
questions.explain: 出盒子 → out of。

lessons.title: 代词 + 限定词：a 是新朋友，the 是老朋友

sections.h: a 的前世是 one，the 的前世是 that
sections.text: a 从 one 磨损而来——「某一个、第一次提到」；the 从 that 磨损而来——「就是那个、你知道的那个」。所以：第一次出现用 a（新朋友），再次提到用 the（老朋友）：I saw a dog. The dog was hungry.
考纲限定词只有两个用法：a + 可数单数；the + 可数/不可数。不用背复杂规则。
做主奏用 I / he / she / we / they；站在动词后面挨「打击」用 me / him / her / us / them：He helped me.（不是 He helped I）。
口语常听到，但书面要写 Tom and I（做主语时）。Part 5 黄区考点。

examples.en: I bought a book. The book is about space.
examples.zh: 我买了一本书。这本书讲太空。
examples.note: 新朋友 a → 老朋友 the

examples.en: Tom and I are in the same class.
Miss Lee teaches us music.
Can you pass me the salt?

lessons.accept: 验收：Part 5 格式的冠词/代词填空 4/6 以上。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：读英文小故事时让她圈 a 和 the，每圈一个说「新朋友还是老朋友？」。玩三次就有感觉。

exercises.q: There is ___ orange on the plate. (a/an/the)
exercises.explain: 第一次提到 + 元音开头 → an。

exercises.q: I have a cat. ___ cat is black and white. (a/the)
exercises.explain: 第二次提到，老朋友 → the。

exercises.q: My grandpa often tells ___ funny stories.
exercises.explain: 动词后面 → 宾格 us。

exercises.q: ___ and I went fishing yesterday.
exercises.explain: 主语位置：Tom and I（不是 Me and Tom）。

exercises.q: Is this ___ pen or mine? (your/you)
exercises.explain: 名词前用物主代词 your。

exercises.q: 改错：I have book.
exercises.explain: 可数单数第一次提到要 a——黄区错误，Part 5 直接考。

exercises.q: I saw a bird. ___ bird was drinking water. (a/the)
exercises.explain: 第二次出现 → 老朋友 the。

exercises.q: Do you want ___ apple? (a/an)
exercises.explain: 元音开头 → an。

exercises.q: This is not my pen. It's ___.
exercises.explain: 句尾单独用 → hers（她的东西）。

exercises.q: Our teacher gave ___ a lot of homework.
exercises.explain: 动词后 → 宾格 us。

exercises.q: ___ bag is this? — It's Tom's.
exercises.explain: 问「谁的」→ Whose。

exercises.q: Look at ___! He can dance!
exercises.explain: 介词 at 后 → 宾格 him。

exercises.q: 改错：Me and Lily are in the same class.
exercises.answer: Lily and I are in the same class.
exercises.explain: 黄区错误5：主语位置用 I，且先说别人。

exercises.q: 改错：She is an university student.
exercises.explain: university 读音以 /j/ 开头（you），用 a 不用 an——看读音不看字母。

exercises.q: 改错：I have dog. Dog is very cute.
exercises.answer: I have a dog. The dog is very cute.
exercises.explain: 第一次 a（新朋友），第二次 the（老朋友）。

exercises.q: 验收（Part 5 形状）：填一词——Where is ___ nearest bus stop?
exercises.explain: 最高级前面 → the。

lessons.title: 连接词：连奏线

sections.text: KET 考纲连接词只有 7 个：and, but, or / when, where, because, if。像连奏线把两个音连成一句，让句子不再一个个蹦。
and 加一句、but 转折、or 二选一：I like apples and bananas. I can sing but I can't dance.
when 什么时候、where 什么地方、because 为什么、if 如果：I was happy because we won.
连接词不光 Part 5 考，还直接抬高写作的 Organisation 维度分——25 词的小作文里放一个 because 和一个 then，就从「蹦豆子」变成「有线条」。

examples.en: I practised hard, and I passed the test.
examples.zh: 我努力练习，然后通过了考试。

examples.en: I like music because it makes me happy.
examples.zh: 我喜欢音乐，因为它让我开心。

examples.en: Call me when you get home.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果下雨我们就待在家。

lessons.accept: 验收：用 because / but / when 各口头造一句，25 词小作文里自然用上 2 个连接词。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：她说任何一句英文后，你问一声 Why?，引导她加 because…。这是最便宜的写作提分动作。

exercises.q: I wanted to go out, ___ it was raining.
exercises.explain: 想出门 ↔ 下雨，转折 → but。

exercises.q: Do you want tea ___ juice?
exercises.explain: 二选一 → or。

exercises.q: I was late ___ I missed the bus.
exercises.explain: 说原因 → because。

exercises.q: ___ you are free tomorrow, let's play chess.
exercises.explain: 如果 → if。

exercises.q: I lived in a town ___ there was a big lake. (when/where)
exercises.explain: 挂地方 → where。

exercises.q: 用 because 把两句连成一句：I like winter. I can skate.
exercises.answer: I like winter because I can skate.
exercises.explain: 连奏线 because 连接结果和原因。

exercises.q: Hurry up, ___ we will miss the train!
exercises.explain: 「否则」→ or。

exercises.q: I was tired, ___ I finished my homework.
exercises.explain: 累 ↔ 仍完成，转折 → but。

exercises.q: We can't play outside ___ it is raining.
exercises.explain: 给原因 → because。

exercises.q: I was doing homework ___ you called me.
exercises.explain: 「…的时候」→ when。

exercises.q: This is the shop ___ I bought my violin strings. (when/where)
exercises.explain: 挂地方 → where。

exercises.q: ___ you finish early, we can play chess. (If/But)
exercises.explain: 条件 → If。

exercises.q: 用 but 连成一句：I can swim. I can't dive.
exercises.answer: I can swim but I can't dive.
exercises.explain: 转折用 but。

exercises.q: 用 when 连成一句：I was five. I started school.
exercises.answer: When I was five, I started school.
exercises.explain: when 挂时间。

exercises.q: 改错：I like music. Because it makes me happy.（两句合一）
exercises.answer: I like music because it makes me happy.
exercises.explain: because 把原因挂在主句后面，不单独成句。

exercises.q: 验收：用 because 口头说一句你喜欢的东西和理由
exercises.answer: I like winter because I can skate.
exercises.explain: 意思通顺即可——写作口语都靠这个句型。

lessons.title: 量词 + 比较级：中文认为万物不可数
lessons.hiddenLineNote: good→better→best、bad→worse→worst——最常用的形容词，比较级最不规则。第三次遇见同一条规律：越常用的词，越不规则。现在你可以确认：这不是巧合，是英语的秩序。

sections.h: 中文 vs 英文的数数观
sections.text: 中文认为万物不可数，所以全要量词：一「本」书、一「条」鱼、一「杯」水。英文只认一半：书鱼苹果自己能数（two books），水面包米不能数，要借杯子袋子（a glass of water, a piece of bread）。
能数的用 many（many books），不能数的用 much（much water），a lot of 两边通吃——不确定就用它。
短词加 -er（taller, faster）；长词前面放 more（more beautiful）。为什么？你念念 beautifuler——念不出来吧？语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来。
A 比 B → A is taller than B。最高级前面要 the：the tallest in our class。

examples.en: How many eggs do we need?
There isn't much milk in the fridge.
A violin is smaller than a cello.
This is the most interesting book in our library.
examples.zh: 这是我们图书馆最有趣的书。

lessons.accept: 验收：可数/不可数分类 10 词对 8 个；用比较级和最高级各口头造一句。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：超市里玩分类——「这个英语里能直接数吗？」苹果能、大米不能。判断错了不纠正，回家查了明天再问一次。

exercises.q: How ___ water do you drink every day?
exercises.explain: water 不可数 → much。

exercises.q: There are ___ birds in the park in spring.
exercises.explain: birds 可数复数，a lot of 通吃。

exercises.q: An elephant is ___ (big) than a horse.
exercises.explain: 短词 -er，注意双写 g。

exercises.q: This film is ___ (interesting) than that one. (用 more…)
exercises.explain: 长词前放 more——beautifuler 念不出来，语言是懒的。

exercises.q: Winter is the ___ (cold) season of the year.
exercises.explain: 最高级 the + -est。

exercises.q: 改错：I ate three bread this morning.
exercises.answer: I ate three pieces of bread this morning.
exercises.explain: bread 不可数，要借「片」：pieces of。

exercises.q: How ___ brothers do you have?
exercises.explain: brothers 可数 → many。

exercises.q: There isn't ___ juice left in the bottle.
exercises.explain: juice 不可数 → much。

exercises.q: Can I have a ___ of water?
exercises.explain: 水借杯子数 → a glass of water。

exercises.q: Today is ___ (hot) than yesterday.
exercises.explain: 短词 -er，双写 t。

exercises.q: This is the ___ (good) noodle shop in our town!
exercises.explain: 暗线第三站：good→better→best，最常用最不规则。

exercises.q: My bag is heavy, but yours is ___ (heavy).
exercises.explain: y 变 i 加 -er。

exercises.q: Maths is ___ than English for me.
exercises.explain: 长词前放 more——difficulter 念不出来。

exercises.q: 改错：I drank two milks this morning.
exercises.answer: I drank two glasses of milk this morning.
exercises.explain: 牛奶不可数，要借杯子。

exercises.q: 改错：She is taller then me.
exercises.explain: 比较用 than，不是 then（然后）——拼写陷阱。

exercises.q: 验收：用最高级说一句你们班/乐团里的事
exercises.answer: Lily is the youngest player in our orchestra.
exercises.explain: the + -est + in 范围。（意思对即可）
